text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The day of her make-debut. Expectations for Duramente 
were running high. She declared she would 
prove the blood of her family.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
But the moment she entered the waiting room... 
she was visibly too tense. 
The expectations must have turned into pressure.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So I told her: "It does not have to be perfect the first time." 
--Her father's words.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Those words loosened the tension, and Duramente 
headed out to her debut race composed.
